title: Why Finance Is Just As Important As Faith and Family
author: By Brad Skiles, CLU · ChFC · CFP® · CLTC
summary: Every culture rests on a three-legged stool: Faith, Family, and Finance. All three matter, but they don't matter in the same way. Faith shapes eternity. Family shapes identity. And Finance, though often misunderstood, shapes the stability of everything else.
